steps.title: Prepare culture medium
steps.instruction: Combine 445 mL serum‑free DMEM (Nacalai Tesque, cat 08458‑16), 50 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (Gibco, cat 10270‑106) and 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (Nacalai Tesque, cat 09367‑34) to a final volume of 500 mL (89 % DMEM, 10 % FBS, 1 % PS). Heat FBS at 56 °C for 30 min, filter through a 0.2 µm filter, and store at 4 °C (stable ≥1 month).

steps.title: Prepare PEI‑Max solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.04 g PEI‑Max (Polysciences, cat 24765‑1, 1 µg/µL) in 40 mL deionized water (Nacalai Tesque, cat 06442‑95), adjust pH to 7.4 with NaOH (Nacalai Tesque, cat 31511‑05), and store at 4 °C (stable ≥6 months).

steps.title: Prepare plasmid solution
steps.instruction: Just before use, mix 564 µL serum‑free DMEM (cat 08458‑16), 6 µL EGFP‑VGLL3/pMXs‑puro plasmid (1 µg/µL, Cell Biolabs, cat RTV‑012) to give 10 µg/mL plasmid, and 30 µL PEI‑Max solution (from step 2) to obtain 50 ng/mL PEI‑Max; total volume 600 µL. Use high‑quality plasmid DNA purified by cesium chloride gradient or endotoxin‑free maxiprep (1 µg/µL).

steps.title: Seed Plat‑E cells
steps.instruction: Plate 2.5 × 10⁶ Plat‑E cells (Cell Biolabs, cat RV‑101) in each 10‑cm dish (Nippon Genetics, cat FG‑2090) with 10 mL culture medium (step 1).

steps.title: Incubate cells overnight
steps.instruction: Place dishes in a 5 % CO₂ incubator at 37 °C and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Add plasmid solution
steps.instruction: Dropwise add 600 µL plasmid solution (step 3) to the culture medium using a Pipetman.

steps.title: Incubate transfected cells
steps.instruction: Return dishes to the 5 % CO₂, 37 °C incubator for 48 h.

steps.title: Harvest supernatant
steps.instruction: When cells reach 90 %–100 % confluency (Day 4), collect 10 mL culture supernatant into a 15 mL tube (Thermo Fisher, cat 339650).

steps.title: Low‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C using centrifuge LC‑200.

steps.title: Transfer clarified supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 9 mL of the cleared supernatant to a new 15 mL tube (AS ONE, cat 1‑3500‑01).

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge virus
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 8,000 × g for 16 h at 4 °C using centrifuge AX‑321 (see General note 1).

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Using an aspirator and Pipetman, remove the supernatant, leaving the virus pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend virus pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 40 µL PBS (Nacalai Tesque, cat 14249‑95) containing polybrene at 4 µg/mL (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat 107689‑10G). Transfer to a 1.7 mL tube (BM Bio, cat BM‑15). Optional: add Evans Blue (WAKO, cat 056‑04061) to achieve a final concentration of 0.1 %–1 % for visualization.

steps.title: Keep virus on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on an ice bath (4 °C) and keep until use; the suspension is stable for up to 12 h on ice.

steps.title: Prepare mouse
steps.instruction: Select an 8–10‑week‑old male C57BL/6J mouse (Japan SLC, cat C57BL/6JmsSlc).

steps.title: Induce myocardial infarction
steps.instruction: Open the thorax, ligate the descending coronary artery with 8‑0 braided silk (NATSUME SEISAKU, cat M6‑80B2) as described by Maruyama et al. [6] to create an MI model.

steps.title: Inject retrovirus into myocardium
steps.instruction: Using a 29G 0.5 mL syringe (TERUMO, cat SS‑10M2913), inject 20 µL of the virus suspension (step 13) 1–2 mm below the ligation site. Insert the needle at a 5°–15° angle from the base toward the apex, bury the bevel, and make no more than two punctures.

steps.title: Close chest
steps.instruction: Suture the thoracic incision with 5‑0 braided silk (NATSUME SEISAKU, cat ER12‑50B1).

steps.title: Provide artificial respiration
steps.instruction: Connect the mouse to a respirator and ventilate for at least 30 min with a tidal volume of 0.5 mL at 120 breaths per minute.

steps.title: Post‑operative recovery
steps.instruction: Place the mouse prone in its cage on a heating pad until it recovers from anesthesia.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol has been used and validated ( Figure 3 ) in the following research article: Horii et al. [5] VGLL3 is a mechanosensitive protein that promotes cardiac fibrosis through liquid–liquid phase separation. Nature Communicati ons ( Figure 1k ). Figure 3. Nuclear localization of EGFP-VGLL3 in myofibroblasts in the left ventricle of myocardial infarction (MI) murine hearts on day 3. This figure is reused from Horii et al. [5]. The intracellular localization of EGFP-VGLL3 in cardiac myofibroblasts was assessed using immunohistochemistry. Myofibroblasts were labeled by staining with αSMA, a major marker. The white arrowheads in the merged image indicate representative signals of VGLL3 in the nucleus of cardiac myofibroblasts. The mouse heart was fixed in 4% PFA/0.1 M phosphate buffer overnight. Scale bar = 20 μm. Our immunohistochemical analysis revealed that EGFP-VGLL3 is retrovirally expressed specifically in cells that are positive for PDGFRα and is not expressed in endothelial cells (CD31-positive cells), leukocytes (CD11b cells), and pericytes (NG2-positive cells) ( Figure 4 ). Figure 4. EGFP-VGLL3 was not expressed in endothelial cells, leukocytes, or pericytes in the left ventricle of infarcted mouse hearts three days after injection of retrovirus. Representative images in immunohistochemistry assessed for EGFP-VGLL3, PDGFRα (a fibroblast marker), CD31 (an endothelial cell marker), CD11b (a leukocyte marker), and NG2 (a pericyte marker). The white arrows in the images indicate representative signals of EGFP-VGLL3. The mouse heart was fixed in 4% PFA/0.1 M phosphate buffer overnight. Scale bar = 20 μm.
